title: MTA Prepares for Winter Storm
creator: Marc A. Hermann / MTA (Metropolitan Transportation Authority of the State of New York)
alt: A subway car equipment maintainer in a blue hard hat, safety glasses and white work gloves kneels beside the truck (bogie) of a New York subway car and works on the third-rail shoe beam, fitting a yellow ice-scraper shoe.
notes: Coney Island Maintenance Facility, Brooklyn, New York, USA; 2020-12-15. MTA New York City Transit Car Equipment Maintainers installing ice-scraper shoes on an R160 train before a winter storm (depot bogie work). Face in profile behind a COVID-era face mask and safety glasses - not dominant. Small legible text: red maker plate on the truck frame (top centre, 'Kawasaki') and 'Princeton Tec' on the headlamp strap. 4887 x 3464. Same file on Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MTA_Prepares_for_Winter_Storm_(50723589951).jpg. Licence re-checked on the Flickr photo page (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0) and on the Commons file page (cc-by-2.0). Author-requested attribution: "Marc A. Hermann / MTA"

title: USACE continues repairs at 17th Street Canal PCCP, 6 March 2024 - 1
creator: Team New Orleans, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
alt: Seen from behind, a contractor in a yellow hard hat, clear face shield, work gloves and hi-vis vest grinds the steel suction intake inside a pump bay at a New Orleans canal pumping station, sparks spraying across the curved metal wall.
notes: 17th Street Canal Permanent Canal Closures and Pumps (PCCP) station, New Orleans, Louisiana, USA; 2024-03-06. Per the USACE caption, workers grind the formed suction intake adapter in the bay of Pump 4 to prepare it for anode studs (pump-station maintenance). Worker is a construction contractor, not military; no face visible. Small logos: 'Kiewit' on the hard hat, Nike swoosh on the hoodie sleeve; vest print 'Think! Safety - Nobody gets hurt'. Proper PPE (hard hat, full face shield, gloves). Caveat: sparks inside a steel pipe read as metalwork more than 'water' - the card label should name pump stations. 4847 x 3225. US federal government work (Flickr: Public Domain Mark 1.0; Commons: PD-USGov-Military-Army-USACE, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:USACE_continues_repairs_at_17th_Street_Canal_PCCP,_6_March_2024_-_1.jpg). Licence re-checked on the Flickr photo page and on the Commons file page.

title: Vlakmeting
creator: S.J. de Waard
alt: Working from a pit beneath the hull of a barge in a covered dry dock, an inspector in red coveralls presses an ultrasonic probe against the bottom plating with one raised hand and reads the thickness gauge held in the other.

hotspots.label: Hand + ultrasonic probe on hull plate

notes: Bottom-plate thickness survey ('vlakmeting') of the barge Stella Maris during its 2013 refit, Netherlands (sibling files in Category:Stella Maris refit 2013 place the refit at the Jochem Smit yard, Hardinxveld-Giessendam); 2013-05-07, Nikon D90. Dry-dock inspection with hands + instrument. Face in profile, partly visible - not dominant. No logos. PPE caveat: no hard hat (covered dock, inspector seated in an inspection pit). 4288 x 2848. title: Elizabeth Engine Replacement
creator: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Norfolk District
alt: In a vessel's engine room, contractors guide a new white marine diesel engine into place on chain hoists; a gloved hand in the foreground steadies a fitting on the engine while a mechanic in a sticker-covered hard hat works the chains behind it.
notes: Chesapeake, Virginia, USA; 2012-10-25. Per the USACE caption, contractors from Advanced Integrated Technology install twin Iveco marine propulsion diesels aboard the Corps vessel (dredge) Elizabeth - marine diesel inside a boat's engine room. Civilian contractors, no military insignia or uniforms. Faces: background mechanic in profile, foreground mechanic cut at the right edge - not dominant. Small text: 'Made in Italy' cast on the exhaust manifold; stickers on the hard hat. 5184 x 3456. Licence re-checked: the Flickr photo page shows CC BY 2.0; the Commons file page (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Elizabeth_Engine_Replacement_(8247685778).jpg) tags it cc-by-2.0 and PD-USGov-Military-Army-USACE (US federal government work).

title: Besøk Troll 18
creator: Tommy Ellingsen / Norsk olje og gass (now Offshore Norge)
alt: Two offshore workers in hi-vis coveralls, hard hats with ear defenders and gloves rig orange chain hoists and a ratchet strap around a yellow steel column on the deck of a North Sea platform, the sea horizon behind them.

hotspots.label: Gloved hands on chain hoist + strap

notes: Troll field installation, Norwegian North Sea; 2016-10-07 (site visit by the industry association Norsk olje og gass). Rigging / lifting preparation on deck. Both workers seen from behind, no faces; no company logos visible. 5474 x 3649. Same file on Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bes%C3%B8k_Troll_18_(30149703431).jpg. title: 2026-04-02 09 50 26 Public Service, Electric and Gas company lineworkers working on a utility pole along Mercer County Route 634 (Parkway Avenue) in Ewing Township, Mercer County, New Jersey
creator: Famartin
alt: Two lineworkers in bucket trucks work at the top of a wooden utility pole, rubber-gloved hands on the crossarm, with orange line hoses covering the conductors around them against a grey sky.
notes: Parkway Avenue (Mercer County Route 634), Ewing Township, New Jersey, USA (GPS 40.2644, -74.8030); 2026-04-02. Utility (PSE&G) crew doing distribution-line work with rubber cover-ups. Faces mostly hidden by hard hats and safety glasses. Small text only ('CAUTION' decal on a bucket); no utility logo legible. Phone telephoto, 4032 x 3024 - slightly soft at 100 %, fine at card size. title: Lemminkäinen Eikemo-utbyggingen
creator: Lemminkäinen Norge AS
alt: In a rock tunnel, a worker in a hi-vis jacket, white helmet with headlamp, ear defenders, respirator and gloves feeds a long black hose towards the rock face while coloured leads lie on the wet tunnel floor.

hotspots.label: Hose tip at the rock face

notes: Tunnel works ('tunnelvirksomhet') at the Eikemo development, Norway; 2012-06-13 (Nikon D3). Full PPE; face mostly covered by the respirator. No logos. 4256 x 2832. Caveats: (1) no heavy machine in frame - hands-on tunnel construction rather than an equipment mechanic; alternate 1 shows a crew with a paver if heavy equipment must be visible. (2) Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 stated on the Commons file page (re-checked); uploaded 2013-05-07 by account Fbjorlo as part of a batch of Lemminkäinen Norge corporate photos (logo, head office, CEO portrait), source and author given as 'Lemminkäinen Norge AS'; no VRT permission ticket on the page - medium licence confidence.
